name: BucksBus
author: BucksBus

sections.description:
Are you new to crypto?

No problem. We create a BucksBus Wallet for you (which belongs only to you and only you have access to your wallet) the first time you log in.

On and off ramps

Buyers can use credit and debit cards payments to on-ramp to digital currencies and purchase in your store in a single-seamless flow.
No disputes with crypto payments.

Crypto payments have a 0% dispute rate. Buyers cannot reverse payments. Chargebacks are not possible.

Cryptocurrencies supported:

  • Bitcoin BTC
  • Ethereum ETH
  • Tron TRX
  • Litecoin LTC
  • Polygon POL
  • Tether USDT (ERC20)
  • Tether USDT (TRC20)
  • Tether USDT (POLY)
  • USDC (ERC20)
  • USDC (POLY)

Supported currencies for automatic exchange rates are:

  • (USD) United States Dollar
  • (EUR) Euro
  • (GBP) Great Britain Pound
  • (JPY) Japanese Yen
  • (RUB) Russian Ruble
  • (TRY) Turkish Lira
  • (BRL) Brazilian Real
  • (KRW) South Korean Won
  • (KZT) Kazakhstani Tenge
  • Can be added more (by request)

Advantages of our service BucksBus

  • Accepting payments safely&keep them in a non-custodial wallet
  • Allow card payments (On and Off-Ramp)
  • Best fee in the market
  • You can choose your preferred coin and exchange between coins
  • Onboarding without KYB/KYC

We are safety

We don’t touch your crypto.
Payments go directly from customer’s wallet to your non-custodial merchant’s wallet – BucksBus just provides the service.

Your funds are protected with 2FA and SSL Technology

sections.installation:
1. Activate the plugin
  2. Visit Admin > WooCommerce > Settings > Payment
  3. Visit the gateway settings for each cryptocurrency.
  4. Complete API Key, API Secret and Webhook secret fields to finish the setup. The instructions for each field are provided.
